raw_definitions: Definisi : adj 1. a. covered with bits of fluff, penuh dgn bulu: after he’d made the beds, his shirt was all ~, selepas dia mengemaskan tempat tidur, kemejanya penuh dgn bulu; b. covered with fine hair or feathers, gebu: a ~ pekinese, anjing pekinese yg gebu; c. soft to the touch, gebu: soft, ~ blankets, selimut lembut dan gebu; the soft, ~ hair of a baby, rambut bayi yg lembut dan gebu; 2. light and airy, gebu: ~ omelettes, telur dadar yg gebu; ~ chocolate mousse, mousse coklat yg gebu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
